PHOSPHORUS
Low-Phosphorus Diet
When phosphorus is high for too long, bones become brittle 
and weak. You may have joint and bone pain. Extra phosphorus 
may go into your soft tissue, causing hard or soft lumps. Also, 
you may have severe itching.
The good news is that with diet, binders, and good dialysis, 
you can keep your phosphorus level under control.
Phosphorus is a mineral found in most foods. Dialysis does 
not remove it easily. Your phosphorus level depends on the 
foods you eat
